note: Each case: the commands that built the drawing natively, the text's path as node.get reads it (textPath), the drawing as native saved it (source), native's .fig export (fig) with its warnings, and that .fig opened natively again: its warnings, the text's path (reopenedTextPath, absent when the text came back as plain text) and the document as saved (reopened). instances: the same for a component whose text is on a path and an instance of it. repinned: six drawings of the older text corpus (each `<name>.figcraft` in native-fig-text.zip) exported and reopened natively at this revision; the corpus's own exports of them predate the change and wrote plain text.

cases.name: a start a quarter along and flipped
a start on the second segment
a path of two parts
exportWarnings: the parts of a text's path after the first were left out

cases.name: text of two lines
exportWarnings: text on a path with more than one line was written as plain text

instances.name: an instance of a component whose text is on a path
an instance text of two lines on its main's path
exportWarnings: an instance's text of more than one line stays on its main component's text path in the file, as an override can't take it off
openWarnings: text path contains multiple lines; text imports off its path

instances.name: an instance text of one line where the main's two lines stay plain text
exportWarnings: text on a path with more than one line was written as plain text
text on a path in an instance but not in its main component, or the other way round, was written as the main has it

repinned.name: text/decorated
openWarnings: text path underline or strikethrough decoration is not rendered
